exams.name: Fundamental Payroll Certification
exams.blurb: Entry payroll examination covering worker classification, calculations, deposits and reporting for new payroll practitioners.

exams.name: Strategic HR Business Partner
exams.blurb: Programme and assessment covering consulting skills, workforce planning and aligning HR practice with business strategy.

exams.name: Talent Acquisition Strategist
exams.blurb: Certification covering sourcing strategy, employer brand, candidate experience and recruiting analytics for talent teams.

exams.name: Certified LeSS Practitioner
exams.blurb: Course-based credential covering Large-Scale Scrum principles, organisational design and multi-team product development.

exams.name: Pragmatic Institute Product Management Certification
exams.blurb: Levelled certification series built on the Pragmatic Framework covering market problems, strategy, launch and product growth.

exams.name: Green Project Manager Basic
exams.blurb: Sustainability credential covering the P5 standard, sustainable delivery methods and environmental and social impact analysis.

exams.name: Project DPro Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for development and humanitarian project managers, formerly PMD Pro, covering the project phase model.

exams.name: Certified Manager
exams.blurb: Three-part examination covering foundations of management, planning and organising, and leading and controlling work.
